limitations: The theorem only establishes strict Sobolev–BV separation for the exceptional BSVY spaces. It does not characterize all singular BV derivatives admitted at gamma=-1, give an intrinsic description of BV(gamma), or address gamma=0. The open-range jump witness is elementary once posed, so unindexed or informal prior observation remains a residual originality risk; the recent source paper also limits search maturity.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
